title: Dictator check versus operational check
statement: Let $G$ be a regular unique game with alphabet size $q$, let $\ell$ label each vertex by an alphabet symbol, and fix a vertex and a sign-valued query check of arity $k$. The check's indicator on the dictator queries determined by the label at that vertex is at most the operational check value using the dictator long-code table, plus $k$ times the vertex's local edge error.
